title: Reproduction code for "Fast covariance-free spatiotemporal modeling via coarse-to-fine learning"
description:
Self-contained code and per-replicate results reproducing every table in the Monte Carlo section and the appendices of Murakami (2026), Fast covariance-free spatiotemporal modeling via coarse-to-fine learning: Tables 1-6 (predictive accuracy, coefficient accuracy, computation time, scaling) and Tables A1-A3 (SPDE mesh sensitivity; Gaussian-process DGP).

CF-STM (cf_dglm) is bundled as standalone R and C++ source in engine/ and src/, so no installed spCF package is required. build_tables.R rebuilds every table from the shipped per-replicate CSVs in about a second; run_all.sh regenerates those CSVs from scratch.

creators.name: Murakami, Daisuke
creators.affiliation: Department of Fundamental Statistical Mathematics, Institute of Statistical Mathematics, Japan
